أبتني (form VIII)
# أَبْتَنِي (ʔabtanī) /ʔab.ta.niː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِبْتَنَى (ibtanā)
# أَبْتَنِيَ (ʔabtaniya) /ʔab.ta.ni.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِبْتَنَى (ibtanā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
